newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian 10-day T-bonds sell at 6.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian 10-day T-bonds sell at 6.25 pct.

text.p: Nigeria's Central Bank said on Friday it sold 8.1 million naira worth of 10-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of 6.25 percent.
Bids totalled 7.474 million naira and the true yield will be 6.2953 percent.
The last sales were 365 million naira worth of 10-day treasury bonds at a weighted average rate of three percent.
The central bank also said that on the primary market, 91-day treasury bills worth 2.469 million naira were sold at a marginal rate of 6.5 percent and true yield of 6.607 percent.
It did not give the figure for total bids.
